fields.statement: Verified commit 19f7def9 (verifier, attempt 1). Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run 'TestShipCheckInfra|TestShipCheckRerunInfraBackoff' -v -count=1: both PASS. TestShipCheckInfra uses fake gh: --infra fails with no red recorded, passes on a recorded infra red (setup log, no failing test), fails on a red whose log has --- FAIL: TestGarden, fails on a green head, and refuses --infra with --settled. TestShipCheckRerunInfraBackoff drives ctx.Now (no sleeps): under --settled --changed --rerun-infra, no rerun 1s before each due time, and exactly one gh run rerun 42 --failed at 5m, 10m, 20m, 30m, 30m (5 total). Each infra-red attempt stays not settled, and Detail names the infra failure and the next rerun at. A later clock with the backoff read back from the state file does not rerun early. Settles and passes on a green attempt, on an attempt red with a failing test, and on a new head. Read the diff: RedAt/InfraReruns/InfraRerunAt are in the ship state, reset on a new red head and cleared on a recorded green. infraBackoff gives 5m doubling to a 30m cap. Other flag combinations are rejected. The whole internal/api package (go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -v -timeout 900s) ran 935 passing tests including all 88 TestShip*, with no FAIL. It hit the timeout inside the unrelated read-timing test TestReadBudgetApply on a host at load avg ~11. describe-golden testscript passes with the new infra/rerun_infra flags.
